answer: Each identity enrols one shale sheet, its fracture pattern scanned at enrolment, and locks 70 units for 8 epochs, refunded at exit. An honest agent pays $35 once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 sheets, $35,000, and 70,000 locked. Per epoch the owner publishes a nullifier hashed from the scan; a second action reuses it, which checkers flag, or needs another sheet. Auditors rescan and compute the delta from the first scan; a copy shifts the detail past the threshold and the 70 is slashed. It stays frozen in a registered tundra plot all term; thawing it free cracks the pattern, so it serves one identity.
